text:
Elaine: quick ops kickoff — we need the final sitemap + redirect plan for the webinar landing + benchmark blog. Target: publish Monday 09:00 PT. Who picks up canonical & redirects?
Sam: I can own redirects and staging test. Need the final canonical URL and list of old paths.
Karla: propose canonical = https://redwood.inference/webinar/inference-benchmarks-2026 (short, stable). Landing should include Event JSON-LD + FAQ schema. I'll drop a small JSON-LD stub below.
Karla: ```json
{"@context":"https://schema.org","@type":"Event","name":"Redwood Inference: Inference Benchmark Webinar","startDate":"2026-04-06T16:00:00Z","location":{"@type":"VirtualLocation","url":"https://redwood.inference/webinar/inference-benchmarks-2026"}}
```
Matt: internal linking plan: add 3 contextual links before publish — from blog post "cost & latency benchmarks", from docs page "deployment options", and from product page hero. Anchor suggestions: "Redwood Inference webinar", "inference cost benchmarks", "dedicated deployment".
Elaine: good. Sam — use 301 permanent redirects for old promo URLs and any /campaign/* paths. Add UTM to external promo links (utm_source=webinar, utm_medium=partner or email).
Sam: sample nginx redirect rule I'll use in staging: ```nginx
location = /old-webinar { return 301 https://redwood.inference/webinar/inference-benchmarks-2026; }
```
Sam: I'll also stage a CSV: old_path, new_path, redirect_type, notes. Example row: `/resources/webinar-inference, /webinar/inference-benchmarks-2026, 301, legacy marketing page`
Karla: reminder for schema: include FAQ on landing for SEO snippets. Short Qs: "What we'll cover?" "Who should attend?" "How to get the recording?" Keep Qs < 200 chars.
Matt: QA checklist: 1) crawl sitemap.xml in staging, 2) run curl -I on redirected URLs to confirm 301, 3) inspect canonical tag in head, 4) Mobile rendering check in Lighthouse.
Elaine: testing steps timeline — Sam does redirects + CSV by Thu EOD, Karla adds JSON-LD + FAQ by Fri noon, Matt verifies internal links Fri afternoon, I'll run final preflight Saturday AM.
Sam: added note — preserve query strings for partner links (use `?` passthrough) but canonical should be without UTM. Will add rewrite rules accordingly.
seo-bot: crawl-summary: staging crawl shows 4 server-side 200s that should 301. See /staging-report/230123. I'll ping infra if they persist.
Elaine: perfect. tagging owners: @Sam (redirects), @Karla (schema/content), @Matt (internal links QA). I'll post the final CSV in #marketing-assets when ready. :thumbsup:
